lines: Ibn-e-Mariyam hua kare koi
couplets.en: Let someone be the son of Mary.

lines: Mere dukh ki dawa kare koi
couplets.en: Let someone bring a remedy for my sorrow.

lines: Na suno gar bura kahe koi
couplets.en: Turn a deaf ear to unkind words.

lines: Na suno gar bura kahe koi
Na kaho gar bura kare koi
couplets.en: Give no ear to unkind words, and say nothing when someone wrongs you.

lines: Ibn-e-Mariyam hua kare koi
couplets.en: Let someone be the son of Mary.

lines: Baat par waan zabaan katti hai
couplets.en: Over there, a word is enough to have your tongue cut out.

lines: Baat par waan zabaan katti hai
Woh kahein aur suna kare koi
couplets.en: There they cut your tongue for speaking, and you are left to listen while they talk.

lines: Woh kahein aur suna kare koi
couplets.en: They can go on talking while you sit and listen.

lines: Ibn-e-Mariyam hua kare koi
couplets.en: Let someone be the son of Mary.

lines: Kaun hai jo nahin hai haajat-mand
couplets.en: Who is there without a need?

lines: Kaun hai jo nahin hai haajat-mand
Kis ki haajat rawa kare koi
couplets.en: When everyone is in need, whose need can one meet?

lines: Kis ki haajat rawa kare koi
Ibn-e-Mariyam hua kare koi
couplets.en: Let someone be the son of Mary.

lines: Jab tavaqqo hi uth gayi Ghalib
Jab tavaqqo hi uth gayi Ghalib
Kyun kisi ka gila kare koi
couplets.en: When you expect nothing anymore, Ghalib, what grievance is left to voice?

lines: Ibn-e-Mariyam hua kare koi
couplets.en: Let someone be the son of Mary.
